Subject: Trace & Retention add-on pricing — initial ask

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — the new tracing samples and live dashboard looked great. A quick ask from our side as we build the business case for our CFO/procurement: can you provide a price sheet for the Observability add-on that covers:

- Retention tiers (30/90/365 days) with per-GB/month or per-token equivalent pricing (we ingest traces + logs together)
- Tracing: pricing by traced-span volume (events/million) and an overage rate; whether sampling or partial retention options reduce costs
- Advanced dashboards: seat-based pricing (we expect ~8 power users initially), and any bundled query/retention credits

We're an early-stage customer (pre-Series B). Would you consider a startup concession or a credits package for the first 6 months? Also, procurement will want a simple monthly vs annual committed comparison.

We may loop in procure@atlasai.com for formal PO. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Park
Director, ML Products — AtlasAI

Hi Sarah — great to hear, and thanks for the clear set of asks. Attached is a compact price sheet I pulled together (add-on-pricing-v1.xlsx) to make the comparison easier. High level summary below so procurement can see the tradeoffs without parsing the spreadsheet: 

- Retention (per GB/month): 30d = $0.45/GB, 90d = $0.95/GB, 365d = $2.80/GB.
- Tracing: $12 per 1M traced spans; sampling controls available to cap ingest and reduce cost. Overage billed monthly at $14/1M.
- Advanced dashboards (power seats): $40/seat/month; includes 100k query credits per seat/month; additional query credits billed at $6/100k.

Startup concession: we're able to offer a 15% discount for the first 6 months for teams < $5M ARR, or a 3-month free trial (no charge up to pre-agreed usage limits). For committed annual deals we can give an additional 10% commit discount (stacking up to 25% in some scenarios).

Notes / caveats: 
- Retention pricing assumes standard ingestion (logs+traces deduped). If you send raw duplicated spans, we can re-evaluate.
- Advanced dashboard seat counts can be capped and overage tracked; we can add a soft cap notification to reduce surprise.

Ben and Marissa — looping you for pricing approval path and procurement assistance. Ben, is the 15% starter concession okay to present? Marissa, can you check whether we can include a 30-day SLA credit for retention queries on the 365d tier?

Next steps for Atlas: confirm whether you prefer monthly (flexible) or a 12-month commit and we’ll share a DocuSign-ready quote.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear sheet. A few follow-ups from procurement and product: 

- Can you do 90d retention at $0.75/GB for the first 12 months if we commit to a 12-month purchase and agree to a $30k ARR minimum? That hits our conservative forecast.
- For tracing, we need a burst protection clause — many of our models create short-lived spikes. Can you provide a monthly buffer (e.g., first 10% of overage waived) or a smoother overage ramp?
- Dashboards: we'd like 10 power seats included for the first year; above that, can you price additional seats at $25/seat/mo?

Procurement is happy to accept a DocuSign link if terms are finalized. They also asked for SOC 2 & data-retention policy docs; can you attach those (or point to a secure link)?

If you can confirm the concession numbers by EOD Friday, we can move to an approval path and PO.

—Sarah
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Trace & Retention add-on pricing — initial ask

Soojin / Marissa — quick internal note (replying-all to keep thread context):

I like AtlasAI — reasonable ARR ask. Proposal we can present: 

- Offer: 12-month commitment with $30k ARR min
- Concession: 20% off retention & tracing for the first 12 months (instead of 15% for 6 months). This gets them under their requested 90d target while preserving ARR.
- 90d retention price (with concession applied): $0.76/GB (rounded) — acceptable vs their $0.75 ask, but I'd accept $0.75 if we lock a $30k ARR and a 30-day non-cancellation window.
- Tracing overage smoothing: first 10% of monthly overage waived; next 20% billed at 50% of overage rate, full rate after that. Add an optional burst buffer add-on if needed.
- Dashboards: include 10 seats first year; additional seats at $25/seat/mo.

I'll convert this to a short concession term sheet (concession-term-sheet.pdf) and mark approver as Revenue Ops for final sign-off. Marissa, can you confirm SLA credit language and whether we need legal redlines on the non-cancel window?

—Ben
